Records when the verification email was originally issued.

ITodoListUserEmailVerification.description:
One email verification event for a user's account registration or re-verification.

Represents a single secure token issuance for validating user email identity. Records issue, expiration, and consumption status for an email verification workflow instance. Used for audit and account validation history. Always owned by a user, and every event has a unique secure token.

page.description: Page number to retrieve (for pagination). Must be at least 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page. Typical maximum is 100.

oneOf.description: Filter: Lower bound for creation date (ISO8601 UTC).

created_from.description: Optional filter for earliest creation timestamp to include in results.

oneOf.description: Filter: Upper bound for creation date (ISO8601 UTC).

created_to.description: Optional filter for latest creation timestamp to include in results.

oneOf.description: Filter: true to include only consumed verifications, false for unconsumed.

consumed.description: Optional filter to restrict events to consumed or unconsumed only. When null, both are included.

oneOf.description: Filter: true to include only expired verifications, false for unexpired.

expired.description: Optional filter to restrict events to expired or unexpired only. When null, both are included.

ITodoListUserEmailVerification.IRequest.description:
Request parameters to search or filter the authenticated user's email verification event history.

Supports pagination, filtering by creation date range, and status flags for consumption or expiry. All parameters are optional; defaults return all user's events paginated.

id.description: Unique identifier of the password reset event. Generated as a UUID at the moment of creation. Serves as the primary key for the reset log entry. Used internally for traceability and event linkage.

todo_list_user_id.description: Identifier of the user who initiated and owns this password reset event. Foreign key referencing the todo_list_users.id. Access is strictly limited to the owner for privacy and security.

reset_token.description: Secure, cryptographically random, single-use token for password reset. Unique per event. Used for password reset verification workflows and as the externally consumed identifier for this operation.

oneOf.description: Timestamp in UTC (ISO 8601) when this password reset token was consumed (i.e., password successfully reset). Null if unused or simply expired.

consumed_at.description: Timestamp for recording redemption of the password reset. Null if unused or expired; otherwise it represents the one-time usage event.

expires_at.description: Datetime when this reset token/link becomes invalid and can no longer be used. Must be checked for expiry prior to accepting any reset operations.

created_at.description: Precise timestamp when the reset request was initiated. Set in UTC (ISO 8601) for auditing and compliance tracing.

ITodoListUserPasswordReset.description:
Represents a single password reset event for a user.

Tracks one-off, secure attempts to reset an account password. Includes the cryptographic token sent to the user, ownership linkage, timestamps for creation, expiration, and potential redemption, and is only accessible by the authenticated account holder. Used to drive all password reset validation workflows and present security/audit context in self-service account operations. Read-only for users and only mutable by the system flow.

user_id.description:
UUID of the user whose todos are to be queried. Restricts search to this user's todo items only, enforcing ownership and privacy semantics required by the business model.

Typically omitted by end users who are querying their own list—supplied only by system administrators or internals for admin/reporting queries. Ties query logic to the todo_list_user_id column in the underlying Prisma schema.

is_completed.description:
If set, filters results by completed (true) or incomplete (false) status of todos.

Enables users and system queries to select only unfinished or finished tasks depending on context—supports productivity tracking, reporting, and UI view customization.

due_date_from.description:
Filters returned todos to those with a due date on or after this UTC ISO 8601 timestamp.

Useful for finding upcoming or overdue tasks, time-based prioritization, or generating reminders for scheduled todos.

due_date_to.description:
Limits returned todos to those with a due date on or before this UTC ISO 8601 timestamp.

Combined with due_date_from, enables time-range queries for reporting and workflow optimization.

search.description:
Full-text search string applied to the title and (optionally) the description fields of todos.

This property enables user-driven search experiences; supports query capabilities within the core business UI and API search features.

page.description:
Page number for paginated results. Starts from 1.

All result sets in API are paginated for performance and usability; this parameter controls which subset is returned.

limit.description:
Maximum number of todos to return per page, for pagination.

Cannot exceed 100 entries in a single page to ensure reliability and frontend performance; omitted to use the default.

oneOf.description: Created timestamp
Task due date
Todo title
Completion status

order_by.description: Specifies the field for result ordering. Must be one of created_at, due_date, title, is_completed. Defaults to created_at if omitted.

order_desc.description: True for descending order; false for ascending. Default is descending order for most recent or urgent items at the top.

ITodoListTodo.IRequest.description:
Input parameters for advanced search queries on the todo item list.

This DTO is used for complex filtering, full-text search, time-windowed queries, sorting, and pagination of todos in the /todoList/user/todos API operation. Each field is optional, ensuring flexibility for different user roles (end user, system, admin) and supporting production business scenarios ranging from simple list display to analytics/reporting and workflow automation.

id.description:
Unique identifier for each todo item. This UUID is generated at creation and serves as the immutable primary key in the todo_list_todos table.

Each todo item is referenced and managed uniquely within the user's list using this ID. The value is required for all operations involving a specific todo and is system-generated.

todo_list_user_id.description:
Owning user's unique identifier (todo_list_users.id). This is the foreign key linking each todo item to its strict owner in the todo_list_users table.

Data privacy, ownership enforcement, auditing, and relational queries across the application depend on this precise mapping. Required for all cross-user administrative contexts and guaranteed by database schema constraints.

title.description:
Short, required title for the todo item, trimmed of leading and trailing whitespace and limited to 1–100 characters.

Enforces core business validation for the application, ensuring each todo is uniquely recognizable within the user's list. The title must be non-empty, reasonably descriptive, and is displayed as the primary label in UI and searches. Title uniqueness within the user's list is ensured by application logic.

description.description:
Optional extended description for the todo. Allows up to 1000 characters for details, context, or notes related to the task.

Null when no detail is provided. The value is displayed in detail or edit views but not required for task creation or management.

due_date.description:
Optional due date for the todo in ISO 8601 UTC format. Value must be a valid date in the present or future if set; null indicates no due date.

Tasks without a due date are considered floating and prioritized accordingly in UI sorting and reminders.

is_completed.description:
Completion status of the todo. True if this item is finished, false otherwise.

This property is user-modifiable only by the owning user and is strictly used to drive workflow status and completion logic in the application.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the todo was completed. Expressed in ISO 8601 UTC format or null if not completed. Handled by system logic: set upon completion and cleared if undone. Never directly editable by clients.

created_at.description: System-managed timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC) for todo creation. Set at insertion and readonly for all users, used for sorting and audit trails.

updated_at.description: System-managed timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC) for last modification of the todo. Automatically updated on any change to this entity. Readonly for users and used in audit logs and synchronization flows.

ITodoListTodo.description:
Table of actionable todo items for users.

Every todo is strictly owned by a single user, enforced by the todo_list_user_id foreign key reference to the user table. This schema now includes all validated business fields: required title, owner linkage, optional description, optional due date, completion workflow tracked by is_completed and completed_at, as well as creation and modification audit fields.

All access is private to owners, relationships and audits are powered by unique identifiers, and every field is compliant with database and business rules as described in the Prisma schema. The todo_list_user_id property is essential for privacy, search operations, admin access, and organizational workflow visibility.

title.description:
Short, required title for the todo item. Must be between 1 and 100 characters, trimmed of whitespace.

Business logic enforces meaningful, non-empty titles. Title uniqueness within the user's list is ensured at the application level.

description.description:
Optional longer description for the todo, up to 1000 characters. If omitted or null, the todo stores no extended detail.

Used for notes, context, or additional task requirements relevant to the user.

due_date.description:
Optional due date in ISO 8601 UTC format. If provided, must be current or future date; if null or omitted, the todo will have no due date.

Permits users to organize and schedule tasks for future execution and reminders.

ITodoListTodo.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a new todo item for the authenticated user.

Title is mandatory, with optional description and due_date for flexible task creation. All ownership, audit, and workflow fields are handled by the service logic and must not be included in the request body. The new todo is always owned by and accessible to the authenticated user.

title.description: Short, trimmed title for the todo item. Required (1–100 characters). Must be non-empty and unique only within the context of the authenticated user. Applies all validation rules as enforced by the todo_list_todos schema.

oneOf.description: Optional extended detail for the todo item. Permitted up to 1000 characters. Null or empty string is allowed. Used for business notes, clarifications, or extended content.
No detail provided for this todo item.

description.description: Optional extended detail for the todo item. Permitted up to 1000 characters. Null or empty string is allowed. Used for business notes, clarifications, or extended content.

oneOf.description: Optional due date for the todo in ISO 8601 UTC format. Must be present or future if set. Null accepted for floating/no-due-date todos.
No due date set for this todo item.

due_date.description: Optional due date for the todo in ISO 8601 UTC format. Must be present or future if set. Null accepted for floating/no-due-date todos.

is_completed.description: Completion status of the todo. True if finished, false if pending. Changing from false to true completes the task and sets completed_at. Changing from true to false reopens the task and clears completed_at.

ITodoListTodo.IUpdate.description: DTO schema for updates to an existing todo item. Fields are optional, with partial updates permitted. Only core business fields can be edited by users; all system fields and ownership are managed by the backend. Validation rules reflect those of todo_list_todos. Ownership cannot be transferred via update.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for the email verification record, as assigned in the todo_list_user_email_verifications table. Used for auditability and referencing events.

verification_token.description: The randomly generated, unique, single-use token issued for user email verification. Used in verification links and to prevent replay attacks.

oneOf.description: UTC timestamp when the verification was consumed. Set when the associated verification link is used. Remains null if unused or expired.
Verification has not yet been consumed or expired.

consumed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the verification was consumed. Set when the associated verification link is used. Remains null if unused or expired.

expires_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC) when the email verification expires. Immutable once issued. Used to enforce security windows for verification actions.

ITodoListUserEmailVerification.ISummary.description: Schema summarizing verification events for user email activation. Used for tracking redeemable tokens, their status, consumption, and expiration. Based on todo_list_user_email_verifications. Includes identifying and audit fields without sensitive user information.

id.description: Unique identifier for this password reset event, generated as a UUID at the time of request creation. Serves as the security/audit key for the reset process.

todo_list_user_id.description: Foreign key referencing the user who owns this password reset request. Maps to todo_list_users.id. Used for access control and event linkage.

reset_token.description: Cryptographically secure, single-use password reset token. Unique for each reset event. Used in the reset URL delivered to the user.

oneOf.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC) of when this password reset was used to successfully change a password. Null if the token was never used or is expired.
Field is null if the reset has not been consumed.

consumed_at.description: Redemption time for this token, or null if not yet redeemed.

expires_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format indicating when the reset token will expire. After this time, the token is invalid for security reasons.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp marking when this reset request was created. Used for audit and history tracking.

ITodoListUserPasswordReset.ISummary.description:
Summary schema for password reset audit log entry.

Represents a single password reset request/flow for an end user. Includes core identity, token, timestamps, and owner linkage, but omits sensitive or rarely required implementation details for list views, business reporting, or compliance analysis.

Use this summary for overviews, filtering, and relational embedding in larger user audits or account management responses. Contains security-relevant and audit-traceable fields only. All fields correspond to the todo_list_user_password_resets Prisma model.

id.description: Unique identifier for this todo item. Generated as UUID at creation and used as entity key, API path parameter, and business reference.

todo_list_user_id.description: Owning user's unique identifier (todo_list_users.id). Used for access control and relational queries.

title.description: Short, required, and trimmed title for this todo item. Maximum 100 characters. Must be unique within the user's business context. Used for list UI and quick search.

oneOf.description: Extended optional notes or extra detail for the todo item, up to 1000 characters.
Field is null if the user has not set a description.
Optional due date in ISO 8601 UTC format. Null if the task is floating.
Field is null if no due date.

due_date.description: Due date/time for the todo item (nullable).

is_completed.description: Current status of the todo item. True if this item is complete, false if still pending. Managed by business logic, updated by user or system.

oneOf.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format indicating when this todo was marked complete, or null if never completed.
Field is null if never completed.

created_at.description: System-managed UTC creation timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Read only in list/view contexts.

updated_at.description: Latest update/modification timestamp for this todo. Updated automatically on every change (ISO 8601 UTC, read-only).

ITodoListTodo.ISummary.description:
Summary schema for an actionable todo item for list or overview responses.

Captures the main business, workflow, and UI search fields describing a user-created task. Provides the minimal context, ownership, completion status, and auditing info for overviews, search, or relational embedding in other DTOs.

All fields map directly to database columns on todo_list_todos. Long form text is truncated and all nullable fields modeled as oneOf (null or value) for accurate API serialization.
